subject: economics
objective: What compound growth rate does this series imply?
instruction: Southfield wants to compare output with population over a short span: Real output was USD 300,000,000 at the start and USD 372,000,000 at the end of a span of 4 year(s), while the population went from 2,000,000 to 2,100,000. Use compound (geometric) annual rates: g = (end / start)^(1/periods) - 1, applied separately to output, to population and to output per person. Periods are years. Required: average annual growth rate, population growth rate, growth gap, per capita start, per capita end, per capita annual growth rate.
